Since mlflow-pipelines wraps mlflow 1.30.0 and the vulnerable code is part of the mlflow server's request handling, it is present in the installed artifact. The fixed version (2.9.2) is far beyond the maximum conda-forge version of mlflow-pipelines (1.30.0), so no patched version exists in the conda-forge channel. The affected_versions set accurately reflects all conda-forge shipped versions of this package.
